Name: Bonsai Fruit Trees
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
Everyone likes bonsai trees. Whats even better than a bonsai tree? A bonsai tree that produces your favourite fruit!

Unlock the fruit bonsai tree recipes as you level up your farming skill. The recipe is one sapling of the original tree. Pierre also sells a few random bonsai saplings every day.

Fruit bonsai trees can only be planted in pots (and will die if left outside in the wrong season), so they can be enjoyed indoors any time of the year! They don't even have to be watered!

Bonsai trees take a full season to grow and once fully grown produce every three days.
